skipped.reason: Rejected. The sound-samples page allows use in a finished work but forbids selling or redistributing the files as samples or as a sampler instrument. That is a custom licence, not CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA, or public domain.

The library is CC0 and the GitHub tree is fetchable, but its notes are a sparse grid (about a minor third or a fifth apart). No catalog voicing of these chords is covered, so the files were not used. The Freesound copies of the same grid disagree between title and filename.
Searches for instrument notes returned photographs, a G-major pizzicato scale, and one short pizzicato file. None of those is a pitch-checked single note for every tone of one of these chords.
